featurePlaybooks.label: Add property
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I add a property?
steps: Click **Add property** (or connect a new WordPress site).
Enter site URL, credentials, and save.

featurePlaybooks.label: Enable site
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I enable a property?
steps: Find the property in the roster.
Toggle the enable switch next to the property name (green = enabled).

featurePlaybooks.label: Site credentials
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I edit site credentials?
steps: Update username, app password, or site URL in the property panel and save.

featurePlaybooks.label: Multi-site roster
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I manage multiple properties?
steps: Each connected WordPress site appears as a property tile.
Use the header property picker to switch the active workspace property.

featurePlaybooks.label: OpenRouter key
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I add my OpenRouter API key?
steps: Paste your OpenRouter API key in the **OpenRouter** field.

featurePlaybooks.label: DataForSEO key
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I add my DataForSEO API key?

featurePlaybooks.label: Per-site rules
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I edit master rules for a site?
steps: Select the property from the roster.
Edit client instructions in the **Master Rules** editor and save.

featurePlaybooks.label: Workspace storage
featurePlaybooks.question: Where are master rules stored?
steps: Saved rules are stored in browser localStorage per property. Use Dashboard workspace backup to persist settings on the server.

featurePlaybooks.label: Default model
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I change the default AI model?
steps: Pick the default OpenRouter model from the model selector.

featurePlaybooks.label: Temperature
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I adjust AI temperature?

featurePlaybooks.label: Max tokens
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I change max tokens?

featurePlaybooks.label: GSC connection
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I connect Google Search Console?
steps: Configure **Google Search Console** credentials for the property.

featurePlaybooks.label: GA4 connection
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I connect Google Analytics?

featurePlaybooks.label: GBP credentials
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I connect Google Business Profile?
steps: Configure **Google Business Profile** OAuth and location settings.

featurePlaybooks.label: Invite user
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I invite a team member?

featurePlaybooks.label: Access roles
featurePlaybooks.question: How do user roles work?
steps: When adding a member, set **Access role** (owner, admin, member, etc.).
Roles control Teams module write access.

featurePlaybooks.label: Member profiles
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I view team member profiles?
steps: Browse the member roster for display names, emails, and job titles.

featurePlaybooks.label: Create a channel
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I create a channel?

featurePlaybooks.label: Send a direct message
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I send a direct message?
steps: Select a team member and start typing in the composer.

featurePlaybooks.label: Threads
featurePlaybooks.question: How do threads work in Chat?
steps: Click **Reply in thread** on a message to open the thread panel.
Send replies in the thread composer.

featurePlaybooks.label: Upload a file
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I upload a file in Chat?
steps: Use the attachment control in the message composer to upload a file.

featurePlaybooks.label: Mentions
featurePlaybooks.question: How do mentions work in Chat?
steps: In the composer, type **@** followed by a team member name to mention them.
Check **Mentions** in the sidebar for messages where you were mentioned.

featurePlaybooks.label: Projects
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I create a project in Tasks?
steps: Click **New project** in the projects sidebar.
Name the project and start adding sections and tasks.

featurePlaybooks.label: Tasks
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I add a task?
steps: Click **Add task** and enter the task title.

featurePlaybooks.label: Sections
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I organize task sections?
steps: Inside a project, add or rename **Sections** to group tasks.

featurePlaybooks.label: Pages Posts SAP pills
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I switch between Pages, Posts, and SAP?
steps: On the black toolbar, click **Pages**, **Posts**, or **SAP** sitemap source pills.

featurePlaybooks.label: AISEO bulk meta
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run Opt AISEO bulk meta?
steps: Open the **AISEO** flyout on the black toolbar → **Meta** → **All Meta** or **MD**.
Run the bulk job on selected rows.

featurePlaybooks.label: Row expansion
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I expand an Opt row?
steps: Click a row in the grid to expand row details.
Use row actions such as **AI meta** for single-page optimization.

featurePlaybooks.label: AI meta
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run AI meta on one page?
steps: Click **AI meta** in row details (pages: meta + FAQs; posts: **AI title** then meta).

featurePlaybooks.label: Optimize page title
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I optimize a page title?
steps: Use **Pages**, **Posts**, or **SAP** pills to find the URL.
Expand the row and edit **SEO title** (posts: use **AI title** or **AI meta**).

featurePlaybooks.label: Multi-site pill
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I use multi-site Opt?
steps: Switch the content optimizer section to **Multi-site** when available.
Compare or bulk work across connected properties from the multi-site grid.

featurePlaybooks.label: CSV upload
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I bulk generate from CSV?
steps: Upload a CSV with blog generation columns.

featurePlaybooks.label: Bulk generate
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run CSV bulk generation?
steps: After CSV upload, start the bulk generation run from the toolbar.

featurePlaybooks.label: Prompt bulk
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I bulk generate from prompts?
steps: Configure prompt templates and run bulk generation.

featurePlaybooks.label: Blog import
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I import blog posts?
steps: Import existing WordPress posts for optimization workflows.

featurePlaybooks.label: Press release bulk
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I generate press releases in bulk?
steps: Configure press release rows and run the bulk PR generator.

featurePlaybooks.label: Entity SAP generator
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I generate SAP entity pages?
steps: Configure entity/location pages and run SAP generation.

featurePlaybooks.label: Competitor generator
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run competitor content generation?
steps: Configure competitor research inputs and generate content.

featurePlaybooks.label: Free Flow
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I use Free Flow?
steps: Enter a freeform prompt and generate sectioned content in the Flow workspace.

featurePlaybooks.label: AI images
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I generate AI images?
steps: Enter image prompts and generate assets for content.

featurePlaybooks.label: Proposal research
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run proposal research?
steps: Configure inputs and run the proposal research pipeline.

featurePlaybooks.label: Citation research
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run citation research?
steps: Run citation discovery for the active property.

featurePlaybooks.label: Backlinking research
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run backlinking research?

featurePlaybooks.label: Organic reporting
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I view GSC and GA4 performance reports?
steps: Select a connected property with GSC and GA4 configured.
Use the date range control and section pills (Performance, Indexing, Speed).

featurePlaybooks.label: PPC reporting tasks
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I generate a Google Ads PPC report?
steps: Install recipes **ads-monthly-mom-report** or **ads-monthly-yoy-report** for automated PPC markdown reports.
Assign a property with a 10-digit Google Ads customer ID on Dashboard → Properties.
Track runs under the Agents rail.

featurePlaybooks.label: Plan mode
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I use Sitemap plan mode?
steps: Select **Plan** mode in the workspace header.
Cluster and plan URL groups before running optimization.

featurePlaybooks.label: URL optimizer
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I run the URL optimizer?
steps: Configure and run URL optimization on sitemap clusters.

featurePlaybooks.label: Industry verticals
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I use Industry verticals benchmarks?
steps: Select a property and vertical benchmark package.
Export or run bulk CSV benchmark workflows.

featurePlaybooks.label: GBP posts
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I publish a GBP post?
steps: Select a property with GBP connected.
Configure post copy and publish to Google Business Profile.

featurePlaybooks.label: Content calendar
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I use the content calendar?
steps: Generate or edit AI content calendar rows for the active property.

featurePlaybooks.label: Social creator
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I create social posts?
steps: Configure post copy and visuals, then generate organic social posts.

featurePlaybooks.label: Google PPC
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I build Google Search campaigns?
steps: Select a property and seed campaigns from WordPress pages and GSC queries.

featurePlaybooks.label: Meta PPC
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I build Meta feed ads?
steps: Select a property and generate Meta ads from page copy and creatives.

featurePlaybooks.label: Connect WordPress
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I connect a WordPress site?
steps: Add or select a WordPress site tile.
Enter site URL and application credentials, then save.

featurePlaybooks.label: Knowledge Base files
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I upload knowledge base files?
steps: Upload files or paste manual text for RAG knowledge used in generation.

featurePlaybooks.label: API docs
featurePlaybooks.question: How do I browse API documentation?
steps: Browse endpoint groups in the API documentation browser.

featurePlaybooks.label: Semrush Safe Fix
featurePlaybooks.question: What does the Semrush Safe Fix skill do?
steps: Enable it on the property profile when you want no-approval Semrush Site Audit fixes (missing title/meta/alt, broken internal links and images) via Neo MCP, then a rescan for HTTP 200.
aliases: what does the semrush fix agent do

featurePlaybooks.label: Posts Content Gap Check
featurePlaybooks.question: What does the Posts Content Gap Check skill do?
steps: Enable it on the property profile when you want next-month published and scheduled blog counts checked against the site blog quota, and Blog Ideas (GSC) started when short until WordPress upload finishes.

featurePlaybooks.label: Entities Content Gap Check
featurePlaybooks.question: What does the Entities Content Gap Check skill do?
steps: Enable it on the property profile when you want next-month published and scheduled service-area page counts checked against the site SAP quota, then the locations grid, entity CSV, and missing pages created when short.
